hints.title: Global Digit Frequencies
hints.text: Count the frequency of each digit throughout the entire string.

hints.title: Adjacent Pair Scanning
hints.text: Iterate from left to right checking each adjacent pair of digits.

hints.title: Value-Frequency Equality Check
hints.text: Return the first pair where the two characters differ and each appears with frequency matching its integer value.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Tallies digit frequencies in a fixed array of size 10 then scans adjacent pairs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting frequencies repeatedly for every adjacent pair yields quadratic runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed array of size 10 uses constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses frequency table to validate adjacent elements in a single sequential scan.
